citations.claim: At first violating step 204 approach E is green while emergency active, with NS just yellow at 203 so 0s all-red
One step before, approach E was red and NS was yellow, showing immediate switch to EW green on emergency

counterfactual.change: Removed the single emergency event at t=204; without preemption the normal NS yellow -> all-red (3s) -> EW green sequence is kept, so no all_red_clearance violation in 340 steps.

explanation: Emergency preemption grants EW green immediately: at step 202 NS green, 203 NS yellow, 204 EW green with active emergency. The controller skips the required 3s all-red (and truncates yellow), so approach 1 turns green after 0s all-red. Removing the emergency restores normal clearance and no violation.

violation.detail: approach 1 turned green after only 0 s of all-red (need 3 s)

vision_note: North-south shows green in 201-202 then yellow for only a single frame in 203. East-west is green already in 204 with no intervening all-red frames and stays green through 205 and 207.
